title: SmartLedger product
description: How owners use SmartLedger: active users and retention, shop activation, feature adoption, AI use and sales. Reads Supabase through the read-only grafana_reader role (ADR-0003); load-test accounts are left out.

list.name: action
list.label: Action
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT action FROM audit_logs ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT action FROM audit_logs ORDER BY 1

panels.title: DAU
panels.description: Owners with at least one successful API request today (Vietnam date). Source: user_daily_activity (CORE-018).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FROM user_daily_activity a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE u.system_role = 'OWNER' AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%' AND a.activity_date > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - 1

panels.title: WAU
panels.description: Distinct owners active in the last 7 Vietnam dates including today.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FROM user_daily_activity a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE u.system_role = 'OWNER' AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%' AND a.activity_date > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - 7

panels.title: MAU
panels.description: Distinct owners active in the last 30 Vietnam dates including today, not the calendar month.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FROM user_daily_activity a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE u.system_role = 'OWNER' AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%' AND a.activity_date > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - 30

panels.title: Stickiness (DAU/MAU)
panels.description: Average DAU over the last 30 days divided by MAU. Near 100% means owners use the app every day; a daily bookkeeping app should aim high.

targets.rawSql: WITH active AS (SELECT a.user_id, a.activity_date FROM user_daily_activity a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE u.system_role = 'OWNER' AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%' AND a.activity_date > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - 30) SELECT 100.0 * count(*) / 30 / nullif(count(DISTINCT user_id), 0) FROM active

panels.title: New owners
panels.description: Owner accounts created in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM users u WHERE u.system_role = 'OWNER' AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%' AND $__timeFilter(u.created_at)

panels.title: New shops
panels.description: Shops created in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM shops s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.created_at) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = s.owner_id AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%')

panels.title: Daily active users by role
panels.description: Distinct users per Vietnam date. Empty until USER_ACTIVITY_ENABLED is on in the environment (CORE-018); ADMIN counts are the team itself.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.activity_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' AS "time", u.system_role AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM user_daily_activity a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(a.activity_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: New owners and shops per day
panels.description: Sign-ups: owner accounts and shops created per Vietnam date.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', u.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' AS "time", count(*) AS "owners" FROM users u WHERE u.system_role = 'OWNER' AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%' AND $__timeFilter(u.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', s.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' AS "time", count(*) AS "shops" FROM shops s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.created_at) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = s.owner_id AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly cohort retention
panels.description: Owners grouped by the week they signed up (Monday start, Vietnam time); W1 is the share still active in their second week. Covers the last 12 cohorts and ignores the time picker; user_daily_activity keeps 90 days, so cells beyond about W12 cannot be computed. Empty cells are weeks that have not happened yet. Small cohorts swing widely: read W1 and W4 across several rows.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT u.id, date_trunc('week', u.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date AS week FROM users u
  WHERE u.system_role = 'OWNER' AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%' AND u.created_at >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') - interval '12 weeks'
), activity AS (
  SELECT a.user_id, (a.activity_date - c.week) / 7 AS week_n FROM user_daily_activity a JOIN cohort c ON c.id = a.user_id
)
SELECT to_char(c.week, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Cohort week", count(DISTINCT c.id) AS "Owners",
       CASE WHEN c.week + 0 <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date THEN round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.week_n = 0) / count(DISTINCT c.id)) END AS "W0",
       CASE WHEN c.week + 7 <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date THEN round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.week_n = 1) / count(DISTINCT c.id)) END AS "W1",
       CASE WHEN c.week + 14 <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date THEN round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.week_n = 2) / count(DISTINCT c.id)) END AS "W2",
       CASE WHEN c.week + 21 <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date THEN round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.week_n = 3) / count(DISTINCT c.id)) END AS "W3",
       CASE WHEN c.week + 28 <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date THEN round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.week_n = 4) / count(DISTINCT c.id)) END AS "W4",
       CASE WHEN c.week + 35 <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date THEN round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.week_n = 5) / count(DISTINCT c.id)) END AS "W5",
       CASE WHEN c.week + 42 <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date THEN round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.week_n = 6) / count(DISTINCT c.id)) END AS "W6",
       CASE WHEN c.week + 49 <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date THEN round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.week_n = 7) / count(DISTINCT c.id)) END AS "W7",
       CASE WHEN c.week + 56 <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date THEN round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.week_n = 8) / count(DISTINCT c.id)) END AS "W8"
FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN activity a ON a.user_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.week ORDER BY c.week DESC

panels.title: Active shops per week
panels.description: Shops with at least one successful owner action in audit_logs that week. Reads alone are not audited, so a shop that only looks at reports does not count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', a.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' AS "time", count(DISTINCT a.shop_id) AS "active shops" FROM audit_logs a JOIN shops s ON s.id = a.shop_id WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND a.actor_role = 'OWNER' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = s.owner_id AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Activation funnel
panels.description: Shops created in the selected range, then how many added a product, confirmed a sale within 7 days of creation, and opened the AI assistant. The 7-day window is an assumption the PO has not confirmed.

targets.rawSql:
WITH new_shops AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.created_at FROM shops s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.created_at) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = s.owner_id AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%')
)
SELECT count(*) AS "1 shop created",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p WHERE p.shop_id = n.id)) AS "2 has a product",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales x WHERE x.shop_id = n.id AND x.sale_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND x.sold_at < n.created_at + interval '7 days')) AS "3 sale within 7 days",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_conversations c WHERE c.shop_id = n.id)) AS "4 used AI"
FROM new_shops n

panels.title: Shops using each feature per week
panels.description: Distinct shops with at least one successful owner action of the group. It counts what owners did, not what they opened; compare with Active shops for the share.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', a.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' AS "time",
       count(DISTINCT a.shop_id) FILTER (WHERE a.action LIKE 'SALE\_%') AS "sales",
       count(DISTINCT a.shop_id) FILTER (WHERE a.action LIKE 'PRODUCT\_%') AS "products",
       count(DISTINCT a.shop_id) FILTER (WHERE a.action LIKE 'CATEGORY\_%') AS "categories",
       count(DISTINCT a.shop_id) FILTER (WHERE a.action = 'STOCK_ADJUSTED') AS "stock",
       count(DISTINCT a.shop_id) FILTER (WHERE a.action LIKE 'EXPENSE\_%') AS "expenses",
       count(DISTINCT a.shop_id) FILTER (WHERE a.action LIKE 'DEBT\_%') AS "debts"
FROM audit_logs a JOIN shops s ON s.id = a.shop_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND a.actor_role = 'OWNER' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = s.owner_id AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: AI conversations per day
panels.description: Conversations started and distinct shops that started one, per Vietnam date. Reads chat_conversations only, never message content.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', c.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' AS "time", count(*) AS "conversations", count(DISTINCT c.shop_id) AS "shops" FROM chat_conversations c JOIN shops s ON s.id = c.shop_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = s.owner_id AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sale drafts by source per week
panels.description: Drafts read from voice by AI against manual drafts, and how many AI drafts became a confirmed sale.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', d.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' AS "time",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.source_type = 'AI_VOICE') AS "AI voice",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.source_type = 'AI_VOICE' AND d.confirmed_sale_id IS NOT NULL) AS "AI voice confirmed",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.source_type = 'MANUAL') AS "manual"
FROM sale_drafts d JOIN shops s ON s.id = d.shop_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(d.created_at) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = s.owner_id AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: AI requests by route
panels.description: Requests per second per FastAPI route, from AI's own /metrics. The series appear after the first request since AI started.

panels.title: AI p95 latency by route
panels.description: 95th percentile time to the last byte, so a streamed chat answer counts in full.

panels.title: Sales per day
panels.description: Confirmed and voided sales by sale date (Vietnam). A void later moves an old day, the same way Core's reports count it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', x.sold_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' AS "time",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.sale_status = 'CONFIRMED') AS "confirmed",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.sale_status = 'VOIDED') AS "voided"
FROM sales x JOIN shops s ON s.id = x.shop_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(x.sold_at) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = s.owner_id AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Revenue per day
panels.description: Sum of total_vnd of confirmed sales by sale date.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', x.sold_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' AS "time", coalesce(sum(x.total_vnd), 0) AS "revenue"
FROM sales x JOIN shops s ON s.id = x.shop_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(x.sold_at) AND x.sale_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = s.owner_id AND coalesce(u.email, '') NOT ILIKE 'loadtest+%')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Last audit event
panels.description: Age of the newest row. A large value on a busy day means the source stopped writing or the read role lost access; no value means the table is empty or not readable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max(created_at)) FROM audit_logs

panels.title: Last sale
panels.description: Age of the newest row. A large value on a busy day means the source stopped writing or the read role lost access; no value means the table is empty or not readable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max(sold_at)) FROM sales

panels.title: Last activity day
panels.description: Age of the newest row. A large value on a busy day means the source stopped writing or the read role lost access; no value means the table is empty or not readable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - max(activity_date) FROM user_daily_activity

panels.title: Audit events
panels.description: The latest 500 successful actions behind the figures above, filtered by action and shop. request_id is the only link back to a request; Core does not write it to its logs yet.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.created_at AS "time", a.actor_role AS "role", a.action, a.entity_type AS "entity", a.entity_id,
       a.shop_id, a.actor_user_id AS "user_id", a.request_id, a.metadata
FROM audit_logs a
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND a.action IN (${action:sqlstring})
  AND ('$shop' = '' OR a.shop_id::text = '$shop')
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 500
